sources.title: Dali Ancient Town - Top Things to Do in the Ancient City of Dali - China Highlights
sources.content:
Dali Ancient Town - Complete Information

Overview
Dali Ancient Town is "one of Yunnan's most popular tourist destinations" with "a history of 1,200 years" and served as the capital of the Nanzhao kingdom (738-902). The town features "historical sites, medieval buildings, temples, and streets lined with shops, restaurants, bars, and hotels."

Location: Dali, Yunnan, China
Entry: Free
Hours: All day
Time needed: Half a day
Best visit times: Year-round

Top Three Things to Do

1. Ancient Buildings & Photography
- South Gate: "the oldest and grandest architecture" offering views of Erhai Lake from the wall
- Wuhua Tower: Rebuilt structure providing "a full view of the whole ancient city," beautiful when illuminated at night
- Catholic Church: "The only Bai ethnic-style church in China"
- Grand Marshal's Mansion/Dali Municipal Museum
- Dali Rural Film History Museum
- Dali Art Factory: Converted factory with bookstores, galleries, cafes, theaters
- Red Dragon Well (Honglongjing): Street with red lantern decorations and bars

2. Street Exploration
The town has "a grid" layout with "four main city gate towers" and "no vehicles allowed." Major streets:
- Foreigners' Street: Named for early 1980s foreign visitors; "Dali's oldest commercial street"
- Renmin Road: "The longest street in Dali Ancient Town and the most bustling at night"
- Fuxing Road: "The main street" maintaining "Ming and Qing Dynasty styles"

3. Local Cuisine
Specialties include "rushan (cow's milk cheese), cold chicken rice noodles, and wild mushrooms."

Accommodation Areas
- South Gate: Bustling, convenient, close to attractions
- West Gate: Quiet, close to Cang Mountain
- East Gate: Entertainment-focused, close to Erhai Lake, diverse nightlife
- North Gate: Residential, quiet, less crowded

Transportation
- From Dali Railway Station (17 km): 40 minutes by car, 1 hour by bus
- From Dali Airport (30 km): 1 hour by car/express bus

Best Times to Visit
- March-May (Spring): Smaller crowds, comfortable 20-25C
- October-November (Autumn): Golden ginkgo trees on Yu'er Road
- June-September (Summer): Cooler than most of East Asia, 15-25C; fresh mushrooms
- December-February (Winter): Off-season bargains; cherry blossoms mid-December to January

Sun Protection Note: "The UV rays in Dali are intense all year round"

Nearby Attractions
- Cangshan Mountains (2 km): 19 high peaks and 18 streams
- Erhai Lake (5 km): Biking or motorcycling around the lake
- Three Pagodas of Dali (2.5 km): 1,150 years old

sources.title: Dali Old Town: the complete travel guide - Fabio Nodari
sources.content:
Dali Old Town: The Complete Travel Guide

Dali Ancient City is one of the most famous ancient cities in China. Unlike Lijiang, Dali is more authentic because many families still live there. For a panoramic view, a walk on the walls offers views of the lake on one side and the mountains on the other.

The old town is one of the few in China surrounded by walls. The iconic Three Pagodas of Chongsheng Temple are one of the most recognizable landmarks in Yunnan, built during the Tang Dynasty.

Erhai Lake is the defining landscape of Dali. A 136-kilometer ecological cycling route circles much of the lake, making it one of the best cycling destinations in China.

Best Time to Visit: Anytime between March and October, mostly during summer or springtime.

Transportation: The fastest option is the high-speed train, which links Dali to Kunming in about two hours. From the airport, choose the dedicated shuttle bus.

Health & Safety: Strong UV rays on plateau - use physical protection (hats, sunglasses) and hydration.

Food: Try rushan (a local cheese snack made from cow's milk, grilled until crispy and often served with rose jam) and baked flatbread.

sources.title: Dali China Travel Guide 2026: Best Things to Do
sources.content:
Dali China Travel Guide 2026

Dali Ancient City is a well-preserved historical town in Yunnan Province, known for its traditional Bai architecture, vibrant arts scene, and proximity to natural attractions.

The city's grid layout, flanked by Cangshan Mountain to the west and Erhai Lake to the east, creates a stunning setting. The town offers a mix of historical sites, local markets, cafes, and galleries.

Key attractions include the city walls and gates, Wuhua Tower, Fuxing Road (the main commercial street), and the surrounding natural beauty of the Dali region.

sources.title: Dali Ancient City | Dali Old Town in Yunnan (Ultimate Guide)
sources.content:
Dali Ancient City Ultimate Guide

Dali Ancient City is a well-preserved ancient city in Dali, Yunnan, with over 1,200 years of history. Once the capital of the Nanzhao Kingdom and later the Dali Kingdom, it served as a political, economic, and cultural center of Yunnan for over 500 years.

The city is laid out in a grid pattern with stone-paved streets, traditional Bai architecture, flowing water channels, and flowering gardens. Key features include the Four Gates, Wuhua Tower, Foreigners' Street, Fuxing Road, and Renmin Road.

Local specialties include rushan cheese, Xizhou baba, cold chicken rice noodles, and the famous Three-Course Tea of the Bai people.

Best time to visit is March to May and September to November.

sources.title: Dali Travel Guide 2026: Ultimate 3-Day Itinerary & Tips
sources.content:
Dali Travel Guide 2026: Ultimate 3-Day Itinerary & Tips

For a 2-3 day weekend escape, you'll have time to explore the Ancient Town, cycle part of Erhai Lake, and visit the Three Pagodas.

The ancient town features medieval buildings, temples, and streets lined with shops. The grid layout with four gates makes navigation easy.

Transportation tip: High-speed train from Kunming takes about 2 hours. From the airport, use the dedicated shuttle bus - much cheaper than taxis.

Sun protection is essential - UV rays are strong on the plateau.

sources.title: 大理古城 - 百度百科
sources.content:
大理古城综合信息

基本信息
大理古城位于云南省西部，又名叶榆城、紫城。古城占地面积3平方公里，始建于明洪武十五年（1382年）。1982年2月8日被国务院公布为中国首批24个历史文化名城之一。

历史发展
古城历史可追溯至唐天宝年间，南诏王阁逻凤筑的羊苴咩城为其新都。唐宋时期，大理先后建立南诏、大理国两个地方政权，距今约500多年间是云南的政治、经济、文化中心。

建筑布局
城池采用棋盘式布局，南北纵向三条大街，东西向五六条小街。"九街十八巷"的格局保持明清特色，街街有流水，户户养花。古城四面各长约1500米、高6米、厚12米的城墙设置四座城门。

主要景点
古城楼：文献楼、五华楼、南城楼、北城楼
文物古迹：太和城遗址、崇圣寺三塔、元世祖平云南碑、喜洲白族民居群
寺庙教堂：天主教堂、基督教堂、感通寺
街道：复兴路、洋人街、人民路、红龙井

历史文化
民俗文化包括洞经音乐、本主信仰、大理白剧、白族舞蹈等。民族节日有三月街（农历三月十五至二十一日，距今已有1300多年历史）、绕三灵、火把节等。

特色美食
砂锅鱼、木瓜鸡、酸辣鱼、喜洲粑粑、鸡翅包饭、凉鸡米线、白族三道茶（苦茶、甜茶、回味茶）。

工艺特产
大理石工艺品、白族蜡染、扎染（2006年列入国家级非遗）、邓川乳扇、剑川木雕、下关沱茶。

旅游信息
全年全天开放，免费入场。国家4A级景区。

sources.title: How to Plan a Trip to Dali: Itinerary, Hotels, Transport (2026 Guide)
sources.content:
How to Plan a Trip to Dali 2026 Guide

Dali Ancient City has a history spanning over 1,200 years. The ancient town of Dali, flanked between the imposing Cangshan Mountains and the serene Erhai Lake, offers a unique blend of natural beauty, cultural depth, and laid-back charm.

Transportation: High-speed train from Kunming takes about 2 hours. Dali Airport has direct flights from major Chinese cities. From airport to ancient town, take the shuttle bus.

Best time: March to October, especially spring and autumn for mild weather. March features the famous Three Moon Fair (Sanyuejie) festival.

Key activities: Explore the ancient town, cycle around Erhai Lake, visit the Three Pagodas, hike Cangshan Mountain, try local Bai cuisine.
